scope: Independent quality review of core plan and Certora crosswalk. No repository edits, tests, solver runs or proof-result claims.
reviewed: Current AlchemistV3 and AlchemistRouter relevant source spans

corrections.correction: Measure position collateral and debt deltas from a synchronized checkpoint. A public deposit or mint can first realize historical redemption, so net changes from pre-call stored values need not equal the new amount.
corrections.suggested_obligation: Assert postCollateral=projectedCollateralBefore+deposit and postDebt=projectedDebtBefore+mint under stable dependencies. Keep actual issued-supply and global-debt increments distinct.

corrections.correction: Specify chronological checkpoints and handle oldPacked==0 before the epoch theorem. Valid packed shape alone does not imply a nonincreasing index or ratio<=Q128.
corrections.suggested_obligation: If oldPacked!=0 and newEpoch>oldEpoch, ratio=0. For same epoch require a reachable transition with newIndex<=oldIndex. For oldPacked==0, actual helper returns Q128.

corrections.correction: Do not use repeated public liquidate calls as an unconditional equivalence oracle. Batch skips invalid IDs and preserves internal no-progress effects unless the whole batch lacks progress. Public liquidate reverts each no-progress call.
corrections.suggested_obligation: Compare a sequence of internal liquidation semantics with identical invalid-ID filtering and one final anyProgress guard. Alternatively constrain the public-call comparison domain and retain separate invalid/no-progress tests.

corrections.correction: The existing __burn(tokenId,amount) wrapper calls this.burn(tokenId,amount). Production burn expects (amount,recipientId). Do not copy the argument order.
corrections.suggested_obligation: Use the real burn API with the correct argument order and include an explicit successful burn witness. Do not regard old harness text as evidence of burn coverage.

corrections.correction: When firstTotalAssets!=0, accrueInterestView returns cached _totalAssets without reading current strategy values. A same-transaction injected strategy loss can make a blanket bound false.
corrections.suggested_obligation: Separate fresh-transaction firstTotalAssets==0 valuation from cached same-transaction behavior. Model actual transient reset boundaries. Block/time changes alone do not clear transient storage.

corrections.correction: Reuse properties, not unchanged harness semantics as production evidence. Anchors bypass allowances and use a simplified vault without virtual offsets. Alchemist scene bypasses initialize and writes fixed storage slots. Transmuter uses 1:1 conversions and self-owned redemption positions.
corrections.suggested_obligation: Retain separate proxy initialization tests, compiler-checked storage-layout readers, distinct external actors, exact dependency units/rounding, and real Alchemist/Transmuter/Vault integration. Note the Transmuter reader uses mockAlchemist even if configured alchemist changes.

corrections.correction: Do not assume all intended ratio orderings or cross-contract invariants survive arbitrary authorized admin changes. setMinimumCollateralization can reduce minimum below an existing lowerBound. Transmuter admin can replace Alchemist with an unrelated contract.
corrections.suggested_obligation: Keep these as discovery obligations with possible counterexamples. State benign-configuration assumptions for economic invariants, and separately test the full accepted admin input domain.

positive_checks: No missing source-defined public/external function or receive entry found in core function inventory or property associations. Compiler-generated getters are a separate implicit surface.
Crosswalk correctly labels declarations as lacking committed proof results.
Crosswalk correctly reassesses stale local debt/collateral, changed cover semantics and debt-token supply assumptions.
Current Transmuter source and VaultV2 source match origin/certora for inspected paths.
Global Certora spec is explicitly an unimplemented skeleton. It cannot provide cross-contract proof evidence.
